text:
Maya (AE): Quick ask — University of Cascadia (EDU) wants to move from trial to pilot. They asked for edu discount + volume credits for tokens during semester peak. Request: 30% off hosted API, $0 upfront, 6mo reserved commit (dedicated) with 20% capacity credit, and SLA bump to 99.95%. Also legal asks to keep data in EU region. Need deal desk + finance + legal signoff. Anyone available to approve?

Riley (SE): Quick note: POC uses long-context embeddings and high concurrent streams. Dedicated with autoscale required. Estimated infra delta: +3x peak GPU hours. Can we cap concurrency/burst policy?

Jon (Sales Lead): Can you paste the proposed numbers? Need ARR math and margin hit.

Maya (AE): Proposed pricing draft:
```
list_price_per_token: $0.08
discount: 30% (requested)
commit: 6 months reserved
committed_monthly: $50,000 -> after discount $35,000
capacity_credit: 20% off token billing for dedicated pool
SLA: 99.95% (requested)
data_residency: eu-west-1 only
```

Priya (Deal Desk): Heads up — standard EDU is 20%. 30% needs Deal Desk + Finance. Volume credit for dedicated is negotiable. SLA bump to 99.95% requires SRE signoff and likely higher reserved premium. EU-only ok if Private or add-on.

Carlos (Finance): If we combine 30% + 20% credit margin looks negative at current list. Need committed ARR number and expected run-rate. What's their ARR post-discount?

Maya (AE): Customer expects ~ $420k spend over 6 months (post-discount estimate). They convert to paid if POC meets latency/cost targets.

Priya (Deal Desk): I can tentatively approve 25% + 10% capacity credit pending legal. For 30% we need VP signoff. @Jon please escalate with the ARR math.

Jon (Sales Lead): Escalating to @VP_Sales for 30% ask. @Anika can Legal confirm EU-only and draft any fee schedule for KMS/backups?

Anika (Legal): EU-only storage OK but operational replication/backups may transit unless they buy Private. We can offer EU-only + customer-managed keys for an add-on ($7,000/mo). I'll draft clause for LOI.

Riley (SE): For the POC I'll implement prefix caching + token batching and set a concurrency cap in the sandbox to limit spike costs. Those controls should help justify the credit.

Priya (Deal Desk): Decision path: 25% + 10% capacity credit + EU-only (optional paid KMS) — Deal Desk approved. 30% requires VP + Finance greenlight. SLA 99.95% — pending SRE estimate (likely +$Xk/mo).

Jon (Sales Lead): Agreed. Small EDU concessions OK for pipeline but avoid setting precedent. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Deploybot: Dedicated pool reserved for 'u-cascadia-poc' scheduled for Mon 2026-03-30 09:00 UTC.

Maya (AE): Thanks all — I'll share provisional offer (25% + 10% cap + EU-only add-on) with customer and circle back with LOI. Will ping once VP decides on 30%.

Priya (Deal Desk): Thanks — please include an explicit clause: 'discount applies to hosted API usage; dedicated capacity billed separately' to avoid confusion.

Maya (AE): Will do. Closing thread for now, will reopen with LOI. /cc @VP_Sales
